# Pixel Nest Labs

> We build digital products, pixel by pixel.

Pixel Nest Labs is a boutique digital product and software engineering studio. We design, engineer, and launch modern websites, custom web applications, e-commerce stores, bespoke CRMs, and AI automation solutions for growing businesses.

- Website: https://pixelnest-three.vercel.app/
- Products: https://pixelnest-three.vercel.app/products

## Core Services

- **Web & E-commerce Development:** Modern full-stack web applications using React, Next.js, Node.js, and custom Shopify e-commerce themes.
- **Custom CRMs & Business Software:** Streamlined lead management, workflow pipelines, and tailored operational platforms without software bloat.
- **AI Automation & Intelligent Tools:** Custom LLM integrations, document intelligence, intelligent dashboards, and conversational workflows.
- **Digital Presence & Brand Infrastructure:** High-converting landing pages, interactive catalogues, digital branding, and technical SEO.
- **Enterprise Integrations:** Reliable back-end services, Spring Boot, REST APIs, and Salesforce integrations.

## In-House Products (In Development)

- **Path Lab Manager:** Diagnostic center and pathology lab workflows, test tracking, barcode generation, and automated report dispatch.
- **Simple CRM:** Clutter-free pipeline and lead tracking designed for agile sales teams.
- **Restaurant Manager:** Kitchen order ticketing, table tracking, and real-time menu management.
- **Admission Manager:** Application workflows, document verification, and fee reconciliation for educational institutions.
